deadline_latch: single completion gate: cancel/complete before attach stores pending result; attach resumes exactly once; no structured group wait
sample_anchor: AppModel.elapsedSampleDate + playbackRate; delayed mount/expand uses sample age; rate<=0/paused holds
metrics_cache: identity + line start/text + complete word segmentation; bounded 8; guarded indices
limitations: QA is static/injected; real QQ voice alignment/physical dual-screen remain user verification.
